about.title: About Us
about.description: A centre of traditional Islamic scholarship rooted in community and sincerity.
about.historyBody: Jamiatun Noor Al Islamia was established with a singular purpose: to provide a home for authentic Islamic learning in the heart of Chittagong. Founded by a group of dedicated scholars and community members, the institution has grown steadily, guided by the principle that sacred knowledge must remain accessible to every sincere seeker regardless of background or means.
about.missionBody: To nurture scholars of the Qur'an and Sunnah who are grounded in classical knowledge, strong in character, and equipped to serve their communities with wisdom and compassion.
about.visionBody: A society in which Islamic knowledge flourishes — where every family has access to a scholar, every student has a path, and the light of the Qur'an illuminates every home.

admission.title: Admission
admission.description: Everything you need to enrol — requirements, key dates, and fee structure.
admission.reqBody: Applicants must have completed primary school (Class 5 or equivalent). Required documents: birth certificate, previous academic records, and a passport-size photograph. No prior Arabic knowledge is required for General Classes; basic Qur'an reading is recommended for Hifz.
admission.datesItems: Admission open: August 15 | Entrance assessment: September 1–7 | Results: September 10 | Classes begin: October 1 | Annual exams: May 2026 | Results & graduation: June 2026
admission.applyBody: Complete the online admission enquiry form. Our team will contact you within 48 hours to schedule an assessment.
admission.applyNote: Opens in a new tab. No login required.
